sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उत्तङ्कस्य वरं दत्त्वा प्रायात् सात्यकिना सह। द्वारकामेव गोविन्दः शीघ्रवेगैर्महाहयैः॥
en: Having granted that boon to Utanka, Govinda, accompanied by Satyaki, went to Dwraka on his car, drawn by his large quickcoursing horse.

sa: जगाम शिरसा पादौ यज्ञे विष्णोर्महात्मनः। दर्शयामास तं विष्णू रूपमास्थाय वासवम्॥
en: In that sacrifice he adored humbly the great Vishnu, assuming the form of Indra. The supreme Lord appeared before him.

sa: नासौ देवो विश्वरूपो मयापि शक्योद्रष्टुं ब्रह्मणा वापि साक्षात्। येऽन्ये कामास्तव राजन् हृदिस्था दास्ये चैतांस्त्वं हि मर्येषु राजा॥
en: Neither myself, nor Brahman himself, can acquired a view of that god of universal from. I shall grant you what other objects you may desire to have for you are the foremost of mortals.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः पाण्डवाः पुनर्मार्कण्डेयमूचुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Thereupon the Pandavas again thus spoke to Markandeya.

sa: पुत्रवत् पाल्यमानानि राजधर्मेण पार्थिवैः। लोके भूतानि सर्वाणि चरन्ते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Forsooth, all creatures live happily in the world, protected by kings exercising Kshatriya duties like children protected by their parents.

sa: तीर्थानि चैव रम्याणि वनानि च सरांसि चा चरामि सह युष्माभिस्तस्य दर्शनकाझया।॥ पञ्चवर्षाण्यहं वीरं सत्यसंधंधनंजयम्। यन्न पश्यामि बीभत्सुं तेन तप्ये वृकोदर॥
en: In order to see that hero, Dhananjaya firm in truthfulness, I have been wandering with you for these five years in various Tirthas, in charming forests and lakes. As I do not still see Vibhatsu (Arjuna)O Vrikodara I am miserable.

sa: यद् वारणावते पार्थान सुप्ताञ्जतुगृहे तदा। आदीपयस्त्वं राधेय क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When you set fire to the wax-house at Varanavata for burning the sleeping Pandavas to death where was this virtue of yours?

sa: ज्ञातीनां वक्तुकामानां कटुकानि लघूनि च। गिरा त्वं हृदयं वाचं शमयस्व मनांसि च॥
en: With soft words alone turn away the anger of kinsmen about to utter cruel words, and please their hearts and minds and slanderous words.

sa: सर्व एव गुरुं भारमनड्वान वहते समे। दुर्गे प्रतीतः सुगवो भारं वहति दुर्वहम्॥
en: All oxen can carry heavy loads on a level road. The stronger ones only among them can carry such loads on a difficult road.

sa: ते वयं तं नरव्याघ्रं सर्वे वीर दिदृक्षवः। प्रवेक्ष्यामो महाबाहो पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्॥
en: O mighty armed one, in order to see that hero, that foremnost of men, we shall all go to the Gandainadana mountain.

sa: अद्य कीर्तिमयीं माला प्रतिमोक्ष्ये तवानघ। प्राणाश्रियं च राज्यं च मोक्ष्यतेऽद्य सुयोधनः॥
en: Today I shall recover, O sinless one, your garland of glory. Today Suyodhana shall renounce his life, his prosperity and his kingdom.

sa: अपूरयद् दिशः सर्वा दिवं चातिमहान् स्वनः। तेषामार्तरवं श्रुत्वा वित्रस्ता गजवाजिनः॥
en: Hearing the piteous cried of elephants, horses, breaking their chords, rushed hither and thither, crushing the warriors in the camp.

sa: उत्पेतुस्तेन शब्देन योधा राजन् विचेतसः। निद्रार्ताश्च भयार्ताश्च व्यधावन्त ततस्ततः॥
en: Awaked by the noise, O king, many warriors, still possessed by sleep and fear ran hither and thither.

sa: वनवासे व्यतीते च कर्ण वर्षे त्रयोदशे। न प्रयच्छसि यद् राज्यं क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When the period of exile and the thirteenth year (of concealment) was over and you did not return the Pandavas their kingdom where was his virtue of yours.

sa: ततः शरमहज्वालौ वीर्योष्मा कर्णपावकः। निर्दहन् पाण्डववनं वीरः पर्यचरद् रणे॥
en: Like burning fire having arrows for its scorching flame Karna fought on consuming that forest of Pandava troops.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति व्यासस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वो जनस्तदा। महता सिंहनादेन गङ्गामभिमुखो ययौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said. All the persons there present having heard the words of Vyasa, raised a loud leonine shout and then went towards the Bhagirathi.

sa: प्रसन्नमनसः सर्वे पुण्या वाचो विमुञ्चत। आशीभिबृंहितानस्मान् न पापं प्रसहिष्यते॥
en: Give us cheerfully your benedictions, so that acquiring prosperity with it, we may not be touched by sin.

sa: तत्राप्लुत्य ततो ब्रह्मा सह देवैः प्रभुः पुरा॥ ससर्ज तीर्थानि तथा देवतानां यथाविधि।
en: Formerly the Lord Bramhan having with all the gods bathed in that Tirtha, created all the Tirthas according to due rites, for the celestials.

sa: यच्च शिष्टं विराटस्य बलं तु भृशमाद्रवत्॥ दुपदस्य च पुत्राणां पौत्राणां सुहृदामपि।
en: Gifted with great strength, Drona's son killed the sons, the grandsons, and the followers of Draupada, taking them out one after another.

sa: यथा ह्यमृतमाश्रित्य वर्तयन्ति दिवौकसः। तथा वृत्तिं समाश्रित्य वर्तयन्ति प्रजा विभो॥
en: As the deities live upon nectar, so all living creatures, O powerful one, live upon the food assigned by Daksha.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे पाण्डुपुत्रेण कौरवाः। प्रसन्नवदना भूत्वा तेऽन्ववर्तन्त पाण्डवान्॥ स्वस्त्यस्तु वः पथि सदा भूतेभ्यश्चैव सर्वशः। मा च वोऽस्त्वशुभं किंचित् सर्वशः पाण्डुनन्दनाः।१८।
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by the son of Pandu, all the Kauravas cheerfully pronounced blessings on them, saying, "O sons of Pandu, let all the elements bless you on your way and let not the slightest evil befall you."

sa: प्रतिलभ्य तु राधेयः संज्ञा नातिचिरादिव। दने राजविनाशाय मनः क्रूरपराक्रमः॥
en: Regaining his sense in no time the dreadful son of Radha made up his mind to kill Yudhishthira.

sa: ध्वजे पताकादण्डेषु रथे यन्त्रे हयेषु च। अन्येषु च रथाङ्गेषु न शरीरे न सारथौ॥
en: These arrows he shot at his flag and flagstaff and car and poles and yoke and the horses sparing the body of his-enemy and his cardriver.

sa: सनत्सुजात उवाच अव्यक्तविद्यामभिधास्ये पुराणी बुद्ध्या च तेषां ब्रह्मचर्येण सिद्धाम्। यां प्राप्यैनं मर्त्य लोकं त्यजन्ति या वै विद्या गुरुवृद्धेषु नित्या॥
en: Sanat-Sujata said This true knowledge that is unborn is said to be undeveloped and is developed by asceticism. On obtaining the true knowledge, men leave this world. True knowledge is ever present in the old and eminent preceptors.

sa: मासेनेति च तेनोक्तो धार्तराष्ट्रः सुदुर्मतिः। तावता चापि कालेन द्रोणोऽपि प्रतिजज्ञिवान्॥
en: And the wicked son of Dhritarashtra was answered, "In a month." And in that same time Drona also has promised.

sa: ततो विस्फार्य सुमहचापं हेमपरिष्कृतम्। समाधत्त शितं बाणं गिरीणामपि दारणम्॥
en: Then stretching his huge bow made of gold he set sharp arrows capable of breaking down the mountains.

sa: कृत्स्नमेते विनिक्षिप्ताः प्रतिरूपेषु कर्मसु। युक्ता महत्सु कार्येषु श्रेयांस्युत्थापयन्त्युत॥
en: Appointed of offices of emolument and of other important matters, they will always secure great prosperity.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं च हत्वा स तांश्चैवास्य पदानुगान्॥ अपश्यच्छयने सुप्तमुत्तमौजसमन्तिके।
en: Having killed Dhrishtadyumna and all those followers of his, he saw Uttamaujas sleeping on his bed.

sa: राक्षसो वा मनुष्यो वा नैनं जानीमहे वयम्॥ हत्वा पञ्चालराजानं रथमारुह्य तिष्ठति।
en: They said, we know not whether he is a Rakshasa or a human being. Having killed the Panchala king he wait there.

sa: आगच्छन् परुषो वायुर्मया विष्टम्भितो बलात्। भञ्जन् दुमान् पर्वतांश्च यच्चान्यदपि किंचन॥
en: When the Wind blows fearfully, tearing up trees and mountains and other things, I abate his strength by displaying mine.

sa: तासां तु तेन शब्देन समीपे क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥ क्षिप्रं च समनह्यन्त किमेतदिति चाब्रुवन्।
en: Hearing their lamentations many powerful, Kshatriyas, awaking, put on their armour and came there for inquiring after the cause of their lamentations.

sa: तन्न जानाति गाङ्गेयो न द्रोणो न च गौतमः। न च द्रोणसुतो राजन् कुत एव तु सूतजः॥
en: The son of Ganga does not know the (weapon), nor Drona, nor the son of Gautama, neither also the son of Drona; O king, whence, then, can the son of Suta (know)?

sa: व्याध उवाच अभिवादये त्वां भगवन् स्वागतं ते द्विजोत्तम्। अहं व्याधो हि भद्रं ते किं करोमि प्रशाधि माम्॥
en: The Fowler said: O virtuous one, O foremost of the regenerate ones, I salute you. You are welcome! I am the fowler. Indeed, be you happy! Command me what I will do for you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भूयः शान्तनवं नृपम्। गोदानविस्तरं धर्मान् पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said King Yudhishthira gifted with humility, once again asked the royal son of Shantanu on the subject of gifts of kine in full.

sa: ततो बाणमयं वर्ष ववर्ष मयि भार्गवः। न्यवारयमहं तच्च शरजालेन भारत॥
en: Then Bhargava rained on me a shower of arrows, which I baffled by a (like) shower of arrows, O Bharata.

sa: कार्यं च हृदि मे यत् तद् देवराजावधारय। वक्ष्यामि यदि मे राजन् प्रियमेतत् करिष्यसि॥ वाक्यं प्रणयसंयुक्तं ततः स्यां वशगा तव।
en: The subject that is in my mind is this listen, O lord of the gods; I shall speak it to you, O king, fulfill my desire. The boon, that I demand of you, has connection with your love.

sa: शिखण्डी युयुधानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। भीमसेनो यमौ चोभौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥
en: And Shikhandin, Yuyudhana, and Dhrishtadyumna, of Prishata's race, and Bhimasena, and these twins, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas,

sa: स प्रविश्य महाबाहुरुद्देशज्ञश्च तस्य ह॥ धृष्टद्युम्नस्य निलयं शनकैरभ्युपागमत्।
en: Having entered the camp the great hero proceeded, guided by sings, very softly towards Dhrishtadyumna's quarters.

sa: सम्प्राप्य तु पुनः संज्ञां जामदग्न्याय धीमते। प्राहिण्वं विमलां शक्तिं ज्वलन्तीमशनीमिव॥
en: Regaining my consciousness, I hurled at that intelligent son of Jamadagni a dart, bright and blazing as the lighting flesh.

sa: वहन्तु त्वां महाभागा ऋषयः संगता विभो। सर्वे शिबिकया राजन्नेतद्धि मम रोचते॥
en: O Lord, to see yourself being borne by the Rishis having good attributes, united together in a palankin, is my wish, oking.

sa: वर्षाणि षडशीति तु दुर्वत्ताः कुलपांसनाः। स्त्रियः सर्वाश्च दुर्वृत्ता:प्रतिमेहन्ति या रविम्॥
en: Those wicked men and wicked women who pass urine facing the Sun, live in great infamy for eighty six years.

sa: स तया रममाणोऽथ विश्वामित्रो महाद्युतिः। आत्मजं जनयामास माधवी पुत्रमष्टकम्॥
en: Vishvamitra, of great effulgence, then roaming and sporting with her, Madhvi brought forth a male child named Ashtaka.

sa: सत्कृत्य हि द्विजातिभ्यो यो ददाति नराधिपः। यादृशं तादृशं नित्यमश्नाति फलमूर्जितम्॥
en: Those persons, O king, who make gifts to Brahmanas after respecting them duly, reap excellent fruits proportionate to those gifts.

sa: एवं तव दुरात्मानः शत्रवः शत्रुसूदन्। क्षिप्रं नाशं गमिष्यन्ति कर्णदुर्योधनादयः॥
en: So shall your evil minded foes, Karna, Duryodhana and others, O subduer of enemies, soon meet with ruin.

sa: संरक्ष तात मन्त्रं च सपत्नांश्च ममोद्धर। निपुणेनाभ्युपायेन यद् ब्रवीमि तथा कुरु॥
en: O sire, keep my counsel (a secret) and destroy my enemy by some clever device. Accomplish, what I ask you to do.

sa: ते महास्राणि दिव्यानि तत्र वीरा अदर्शयन्। छादयन्तः शरैर्भीमं मेघाः सूर्यमिवोदितम्॥
en: Furiously fell upon them like a lion attacking other inferior animals. Then those heroes displaying mighty weapons of celestial make.

sa: स त्वं रासभयुक्तेन स्पन्दनेनाशुगामिना। वारणावतमद्यैव यथा यासि तथा कुरु॥
en: Do that by with you can reach Varanavata this very day on a car drawn by swift asses.

sa: सांतिरुवाच एवं संचोदिता राज्ञा मन्त्रिणस्ते नराधिपम्। ऊचुः सर्वे यथावृत्तं राज्ञः प्रियहितैषिणः॥
en: Sauti said : Thus asked by the king, the ministers, the well-wishers of the king, told him everything as it had happened.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच वसिष्ठस्यापवाहोऽसौ भीमवेगः कथं नु सः। किमर्थं च सरिच्छेष्टा तमृषि प्रत्यवाहयत्॥
en: Janamejaya said "Why is the current of the tirtha known as Vashishthapavaha so rapid? For why did the foremost of rivers carry away Vashishtha?

sa: पर्वतं मन्दरं दिव्यमेष पन्थाः प्रयास्यति। समाहिता निरुद्विग्नाः सर्वे भवत पाण्डवाः॥
en: O sons of Pandu, this way leads to the celestials Mandara mountain; therefore be attentive and free from all anxieties.

sa: लोमश उवाच द्रष्टारः पर्वताः सर्वे नद्यः सपुरकाननाः। तीर्थानि चैव श्रीमन्ति स्पृष्टं च सलिल करैः॥
en: Lomasha said: You have seen many mountains and rivers, towns and forests and also many charming Tirthas, the sacred water of which you have touched with your hands.

sa: अद्य मे केकया लब्धाः काशिका: कोसलाश मे। चेदयश्चापरे वङ्गा मामेव समुपाश्रिताः॥
en: *Today the Kekayas are rallying to me; the Kausikas, the Kosalas, the Chedis, the Vangas and others are all betaking to me.

sa: ततो ददृशुरासीनं सह देवैः पितामहम्। सिद्धैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्चैव समन्तात् परिवारितम्॥
en: They then saw the Grandsire seated with the celestials, surrounded by the Siddhas and the Brahmarshis.

sa: तस्यां नद्यां महासत्त्वः सौगन्धिकवनं महत्। अपश्यत् प्रीतिजननं बालार्कसदृशद्युति॥
en: That greatly powerful hero saw, there, the great Sugandhika forest, delightful and effulgent as the sun.

sa: सुखे वा यदि वा दुःखे वर्तमानो विचक्षणः। यश्चिनोति शुभान्येव स तन्त्राणीह पश्यति॥
en: That wise man who, in happiness as also in misery, acquire only what is good, is considered as a true observer of the scriptures.

sa: केन जीवन्ति भूतानि तेषामायुश्च किं परम्। किं सत्य किं तपो विप्र के गुणाः सद्भिरीरिताः॥
en: By what do creatures live? What is the limit of their life? What is truth? What is penance, O learned Brahmana? What are called qualities by the good?

sa: धनं चालभमानोऽत्र नाद्य तत् क्षन्तुमर्हति॥ यथा नायं समायद्याद् धार्तराष्ट्रान् कथंचन। न च सेनाः पराजय्यात् तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥ उक्तं दुर्योधनेनापि पुरस्ताद् वाक्यमीदृशम्। तदनुस्मृत्य गाङ्गेय यथावद् वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: By (merely) recovering the kine he will not forgive us. let therefore such a procedure be adopted that he can, by no means, vanquish the sons of Dhritarashtra and defeat our army. Similarly did Duryodhana speak before. Remembering all this, O Bhishma, tell us what you think proper.

sa: तथारूपां तां दृष्ट्वा मुनिराह महानदीम्। अविचारं वसिष्ठं त्वमानयस्वान्तिकं मम॥
en: Beholding the great river in that condition, the ascetic said to her-"Bring Vashishtha before me without any scruple.'

sa: स तानि रमणीयानि वान्युपवनानि च। विलोकयामास तदा सौगन्धिकवनेप्सया॥ फुल्लद्रुमविचित्राणि सरांसि सरितस्तथा। नानाकुसुमचित्राणि पुष्पितानि वनानि च॥
en: Going in search of the place where grew the lotuses (in question), Bhima saw romantic forests, groves, rivers, lakes, trees adorned with blossoms and sylvan wood-lands beautified by various flowers.

sa: ततस्तु भगवानिन्द्रः संहृष्टः समपद्यत। वरं च प्रददौ तस्मै अथर्वाङ्गिरसे तदा॥
en: saw Then the god Indra became highly pleased and he granted a boon to Angiras who was chanting the Atharvaveda.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतैश्चान्यैश्च विप्रस्य हेतुमद्भिः प्रभाषितैः। पर्यवस्थापितो राजा सेनजिन्मुमुदे सुखी॥
en: Bhishma said Consoled with these and other words of the learned Brahmana, king Senajit enjoyed delight and became very happy.

sa: यश्च योगे भवेद् भक्तः सोऽपि नास्त्यत्र संशयः। विधिनानेन देहान्ते मम लोकानवाप्नुयात्। साधये गम्यतां चैव यथास्थानानि सिद्धये॥
en: He also, who is devoted to Yoga, will, forsooth, acquire likewise, after death, my own regions. I go hence. Go ye all to your respective abodes for the accomplishment of your ends.

sa: बुद्धिमन्तं च शूरं च मूढं भीरुं जडं कविम्। दुर्बलं बलवन्तं च भागिनं भजते सुखम्॥
en: Of the intelligent, the heroic, the foolish, the cowardly, the idiotic, the earned, the weak, or the strong, happiness comes to him only for whom it is ordained.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद् वासुदेव: फाल्गुनं पुरुर्षभम्। दिव्यास्त्रेणैव निर्भिद्य पातयस्व महाबल॥
en: Then Vasudeva's son said to Phalguna, that best of men-"Strike Karna down with a celestial weapon."

sa: अनश्चिाहतां प्राप्ताः सन्तः स्तुत्वा तमेव ह। न तु वृद्धिमिहान्विच्छेत् कर्म कृत्वा जुगुप्सितम्॥
en: Many undeserving men, by worshipping that good god, won great distinction. One should not seek for advancement by committing any wicked or censurable deed.

sa: न युक्तं भवता त्यक्तुं संग्रामं दारुकात्मज' मयि युद्धार्थिनि भृशं स त्वं याहि यतो रणम्॥
en: O son of Daruka, you ought not to have left the battle while my desire for fight had not been gratified. Therefore, go back to the battle again.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मा भूदियं तव प्रज्ञा कथमेवं सुयोधन। यदाभिमन्युं बहवो जघ्नुर्युधि महारथाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said How is it, O Duryodhana, that you had not this knowledge when many great car-warriors, in a body, killed Abhimanyu in battle.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा कुञ्जरं मत्तमायान्तं बलगर्वितम्। व्याघ्रो हस्तिभयात् त्रस्तस्तमृषि शरणं ययौ।॥
en: Seeing that infuriate elephant, proud of his strength, approach him, the tiger, moved with fear, sought refuge with the Rishi.

sa: ऊचुश्चैनं महाभागं प्राप्ता भागार्थिनो वयम्। अथाब्रवीदृषिर्देवान् पश्यध्वं मां दिवौकसः॥
en: Beholding that great beautiful ascetic the gods addressed him, saying-"We have come for our shares (in your offerings).

sa: ये भूतान्यनुगृह्णन्ति वर्धयन्ति च ये प्रजाः। ते ते राष्ट्रेषु वर्तन्त मा भूतानामभावकाः॥
en: Let such men live in your kingdom as advance the interests of others and do them good, but not such as root out others.

sa: संजय उवाच पुत्रस्तु ते महाराज रथस्थो रथिनां वरः। दुरुत्सहो बभौ युद्धे यथा रुद्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Filled with the courage of despair, that best of car-warriors, O king viz., your son, looked resplendent on his car in that battle like Rudra himself.

sa: अद्य पाञ्चालराजस्य धृष्टद्युम्नस्य वै निशि। नचिरात् प्रमथिष्यामि पशोरिव शिरो बलात्॥
en: Displaying my power, I shall tonight grind the head, like that any animal, of Dhrishtadyumna the king of the Panchalas.

sa: अद्य पाञ्चालसेनां तां निहत्य निशि सौप्तिके। कृतकृत्यः सुखी चैव भविष्यामि महामते॥
en: Having rooted out the Panchala army tonight while asleep, I shall, enjoy great happiness and consider myself to have done my duty!

sa: अङ्गमेतन्महद् राज्ये धनिनो नाम भारत। ककुदं सर्वभूतानां धनस्थो नात्र संशयः॥
en: In every kingdom, the wealthy form an estate in the realm. Forsooth, a wealthy person is the foremost of men.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवाः शूराः समरे जितकाशिनः॥ उपयाता नरव्याघ्राः पूर्वां संध्यां प्रति प्रभो।
en: Similarly, the brave Pandavas, those foremost of men, desirous of killing their enemies, encountered one another early in the morning, O king.

sa: प्रमुखस्थे तदा कर्णे बलं पाण्डवरक्षितम्। दुरासदं तदा गुप्तं व्यूढं गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: While Karna was fighting with the unconquerable ariny of the Pandavas, it was vigorously protected by the wilder of Gandiva.

sa: तव शस्त्राणि दिव्यानि मम चैव न संशयः। सात्वतोऽपि महेष्वासो नित्यं युद्धेषु कोविदः॥
en: You are a master of celestial weapons. I also am so. This hero of Satvata's race is a great bowman, always skilled in battle.

sa: ते पिबन्तः कषायांश्च सीषि विविधानि च। न मृत्युमतिवर्तन्ते वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: Taking bitters and various sorts of oily drugs, they cannot go beyond death as the ocean cannot transcend its continents.

sa: एवं राज्ञा मतिमता विदित्वा सत्यशौचताम्। आर्जवं प्रकृतिं सत्यं श्रुतं वृत्तं कुलं दमम्॥ अनुक्रोशं बलं वीर्यं प्रभावं प्रश्रयं क्षमाम्। भृत्याये यत्र योग्याः स्युस्तत्र स्थाप्या: सुरक्षिताः॥
en: Following this example an intelligent king should appoint servants, each fit for the office assigned to him, and exercise proper control over them, having first ascertained their qualifications of truthfulness, purity, sincerity, general disposition, knowledge of the scriptures, conduct, birth, self-control, mercy, ' strength, energy, dignity, and forgiveness.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच गतो वैरस्य निधनं हतो राजा सुयोधनः। कृष्णस्य मतमास्थाय विजितेयं वसुन्धरा॥
en: Yudhishthira said Hostilities have been closed! King Suyodhana has been struck down! The Earth has been conquered (by us), under the advice of Krishna.

sa: फुल्लपद्यप्रकाशानि पुण्डरीकाक्ष योषिताम्। अनवद्यानि वक्त्राणि तापयत्येष रश्मिवान्॥
en: See, O lotus-eyed, hero, there beautiful faces resembling full-blown lotuses, scorched by the sun.

sa: इति सप्तसरस्वत्यो नामतः परिकीर्तिताः॥ सप्ता सारस्वतं चैव तीर्थ पुण्य तथा स्मृतम्। प्रथितं भुवि।
en: Thus have I described to you the seven Sarasvatis, according to their names. I have also given you an account of the sacred tirtha called Satpa-Sarasvat.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु कौन्तेयो हत्वा युद्धे सुतांस्तव। मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं सफलं जन्म च प्रभो॥
en: Indeed, having killed your sons in that battle, Bhimasena, the son of Kunti, regarded his object accomplished, O lord and birth fruitful.

sa: निश्चित्य तु यथाप्रज्ञं या मतिं साधु पश्यति। तया प्रकुरुते भवं सा तस्योद्योगकारिका॥
en: Having resolved, however, according to one's wisdom, he should try to carry out his resolution. Such resolution, therefore, should make him display his manliness.

sa: भीष्मं द्रोणं च कर्णं च मद्रराजानमेव च। तथान्यान् नृपतीन् वीराशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ कोऽन्यः शक्तो रणे जेतुमृते पार्थाद् युधिष्ठिरात्। यस्य नाथो हृषीकेशः सदा सत्ययशोनिधिः॥
en: Who else than Yudhishthira the son of Pritha, who has Hrishikesha, the refuge of justice and glory for his protector, is competent to defeat in battle Bhishma, Drona and Karna and the king of the Madras and the other kings by hundreds and thousands.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। बृहस्पतेश्च संवादं शक्रस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said 'Regarding it, O Yudhishthira, the old account of a conversation between Brihaspati and Shakra is cited.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु कौन्तेयो हत्वा युद्धे सुतांस्तव। मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं सफलं जन्म च प्रभो॥
en: Indeed, having killed your sons in that battle, Bhimasena, the son of Kunti, regarded his object accomplished, O lord and birth fruitful.

sa: स्त्रीणां रुदितनिर्घोषः श्वापदानां च गर्जितम्। चित्ररूपमिदं कृष्णं विचित्रं प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: The piteous lamentations of women, and these cries and roars of beasts of prey, appear highly wonderful to me, OKrishna.

sa: न वामनाः कुब्जकृशा न खजा नान्धो जडः स्त्री च नपुंसकं च। न चात्र तिर्यक् च पुरों न पर्था नोर्ध्वं न चाधः प्रचरेत् कथंचित्।॥
en: There should be no dwarfs, no humpbacked persons, no lean man, no lame or blind man, no idiot, no woman, and no eunuch, at the spot where the king holds his consultations. Nothing should move there, before or behind, above or below, or in opposite directions.

sa: तरसा बुद्धिपूर्वं वा निग्राह्या एव शत्रवः। पापैः सह न संदध्याद् राज्यं पण्यं न कारयेत्॥
en: By power and policy should the king subjugate his foes. He must not allow sin to be committed in his kingdom, but should cause virtue to be practised.

sa: येषां च जगतीनाथो नाथः कृष्णो जनार्दनः। कथं तेषाहं जयो न स्याद् येषां धर्मो व्यपाश्रयः॥
en: Why will they be not victorious who have for their protector Krishna, called Janardana, the protector of the universe? Why will they not be victorious who are righteous?

sa: सारासारं बलं वीर्यमात्मनो द्विषतश्च यः। जानन् विचरति प्राज्ञो न स याति पराभवम्॥
en: That wise man, who acts after determining fully the strength and weakness, the power and energy, of himself and his enemies is never discomfitted.

sa: कथं जयो न तेषां स्याद् येषां योद्धा धनंजयः। सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च द्रौपद्यास्तनयाः पञ्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। शिखण्डी च महेष्वासो राजा चैव युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Why will they not be victorious who have Dhananjaya for their warrior, as also Satyaki and Bhimasena and Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata and the five sons of Draupadi and the Iwo sons of and the great bowman Shikhandin and king Yudhishthira.

sa: देवैरपि न शक्यस्त्वं परिज्ञातुं कुतो मया। त्वयि सर्वेस्म दृश्यन्ते भावा ये जगति स्थिताः॥
en: At the universal dissolution, everything once more enters thee. Thou art incapable of being known by the celestials, how then canst thou be known by me?

sa: ये पुनर्धर्मशास्त्रेण वर्तेरनिह दस्यवः। अपि ते दस्यवो भूत्वा क्षिप्रं सिद्धिमवाप्नुयुः॥
en: Those robbers, again, who would follow the restraints of the scriptures, would soon acquire salvation although leading a plundering life.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ब्रुवंस्तं च यदुप्रवीरो युधिष्ठिरं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठम्। रथेन तेनाशु ययौ महात्मा दिशः प्रकाशम्भगवानिवार्कः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Conversing thus with Yudhishthira, that foremost of pious men, the great Yadava hero proceeded quickly on thai car lighting up all the quarters like the divine Sun himself.

sa: धनंजयो स्थानीकमभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्॥ विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु व्याक्षिपद् गाण्डिवं धनुः।
en: Drawing his bow Gandiva known all over the three worlds the highly energetic Dhananjaya rushed against your car-warriors.

sa: सत्यवाक् शीलसम्पन्नो गम्भीरः सत्रपो मृदुः। पितृपैतामहो यः स्यात् स मन्त्रं श्रोतुमर्हति॥
en: One who is truthful in speech and modest and mild, and who is a hereditary servant of the king, should be consulted.

sa: आनृण्यमद्य गच्छामि हत्वा त्वां भ्रातृभिः सह॥ एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं विरराम जनाधिपः।
en: Today I shall release myself from that debt by killing you with your brothers. Having said these words, he stopped.

sa: नारद उवाच सुखदुःखैरहं त्वं च प्रजाः सर्वाश्च संजय॥ अविमुक्ता मरिष्यामस्तत्र का परिदेवना।
en: Narada said Subject to happiness and misery myself, yourself, and all creatures, Srinjaya, shall have to die. What cause then is there for grief.

sa: महोदरस्य तल्लग्नं जंघाया वै यदृच्छया॥ वने विचरतो राजन्नस्थि भित्वाऽस्फुरत् तदा। स तेन लग्नेन तदा द्विजातिर्न शशाक ह॥
en: That head, coursing at will through the sky, fell upon the thigh of Mahodara while the latter was walking in the woods. Piercing his thigh, O king, it stuck to it and remained there.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच हतेषु सर्वसैन्येषु धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। शुश्रुवे पितरं वृद्धं निर्यान्तं गजसाह्वयात्॥
en: Vaishampayana said "After all the warriors had been massacred, king Yudhishthira heard that his uncle Dhritarashtra had left the city of Hastinapura.

sa: सदा न विश्वसेद् राजन् पापं कृत्वेह कस्यचित्। अपकृत्य परेषां हि विश्वासाद् दुःखमश्नुते॥
en: If the king injures any one, he should never trust him again. By trusting a person who has been injured, one suffers great misery.

sa: नास्ति जात्या रिपु म मित्रं वापि न विद्यते। सामर्थ्ययोगाज्जायन्ते मित्राणि रिपवस्तथा॥
en: There is no separate order of creatures called enemies or friends. Persons become friends or enemies according to the trend of circumstances.

sa: यः सहस्रं सहस्राणां श्वेतानश्वानवासृजत्। सहस्रं च सहस्राणां कन्या हेमपरिष्कृतः॥ ईजानो वितते यज्ञे दक्षिणामत्यकालयत्।
en: He gave away a hundred thousand horses. He gave away as presents also a hundred thousand maidens, adorned with golden ornaments in a sacrifice he celebrated.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ते सर्वमेवानुचुः कायव्यस्यानुशासनम्। वृद्धिं च लेभिरे सर्वे पापेभ्यश्चाप्युपारमन्॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, those robbers obeyed all the commands of Kayavya. By desisting from sin, they acquired great prosperity.

sa: नाविद्यो नानृजुः पार्श्वे नाप्राज्ञो नामहाधनः। संग्राह्यो वसुधापालै त्यो भृत्यवतां वर॥
en: O foremost of kings, kings should never keep a servant who is shorn of learning, sincerity, wisdom and great wealth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच क्रोशमात्रं ततो गत्वा ददृशुस्तान् महारथान्। शारद्वतं कृपं द्रौणिं कृतवर्माणमेव च॥
en: Vaishampayana said “Within two miles after his departure Dhritarashtra, met with those three great carwarriors, viz., Sharadvat's son Kripa, Drona's son (Ashvatthaman), and Kritavarman.

sa: शिल्पिनो वणिजो वैश्याः सर्वकर्मोपजीविनः। ते पार्थिवं पुरस्कृत्य निर्ययुर्नगराद् बहिः॥
en: Issuing out of the city, artisans and traders and Vaishyas and all kinds of mechanics, followed the king.

sa: दुर्योधनोऽऽप्यसम्भ्रान्तस्तान् रणे निशितैः शरैः॥ तत्रावधीत्ततः क्रुद्धः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Worked up with anger, however, Duryodhana killed his enemies, in hundreds and thousands with keen arrows.

sa: संतुष्टाः सर्वसिद्धार्था निर्भयाः स्वैरचारिणः। नराः सत्यव्रताश्चासन् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: During Rama's regime all men contented, obtained the fruition of their desire, and were fearless, free, and truthful.

sa: विक्रमेण महीं लब्ध्वा प्रजा धर्मेण पालयेत्। आहवे निधनं कुर्याद् राजा धर्मपरायणः॥
en: Having acquired the sovereignty of the Earth by prowess, a virtuous king should protect his subjects fairly and kill enemies in battle

sa: अप्राप्तस्याभिमर्श तु कुर्वन्तो मनुजास्ततः। कामो नामापरस्तत्र प्रत्यपद्यत वै प्रभो॥
en: And because men tried to secure objects which were not their own, another passion called lust seized them.

sa: कथं हि मादृशो लोके मुहूर्तमपि जीवति॥ द्रोणो हतेति यद्वाचः पञ्चालानां शृणोम्यहम्।
en: How could a person like me live for even a moment after hearing the Panchalas say that they have killed by father?

sa: उत्थितः स ह्रदाद् स तुद्यमानो बलवान् वाग्मी रामसमन्ततः॥ वीरः प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्।
en: Cut with wordy darts, O Rama, from every side, the powerful and heroic Duryodhana has risen from the lake, armed with his heavy inace.

sa: तस्माद् गोमिषु यत्नेन प्रीतिं कुर्याद् विचक्षणः। दयावानप्रमत्तश्च करान् सम्प्रणयन् मृदून्॥
en: A wise king, therefore, should always please them. Acting with carefulness and leniency, he should impose mild taxes upon them.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रो तथा शूरौ द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः॥ अभिवाद्य स्थिता राजन् रौहिणेयं महाबलम्।
en: Similarly the two sons of Madri and the five sons of Draupadi saluted Rohini's powerful son and stood at a respectful distance.

sa: यथा राजा च कर्ता च स्यातां कर्मणि भागिनौ॥ संवेक्ष्य तु तथा राज्ञा प्रणेयाः सततं कराः।
en: The king should, after proper thought, impose taxes in such a way that he and the person who labours to produce the article taxed may both partake of the out-turn.

sa: गौतमस्तु रणे क्रुद्धो द्रौपदेयान् महाबलान्॥ विव्याध बहुभिः शूरः शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः।
en: Worked up with rage in that battle, the heroic Gautama struck the mighty sons of Draupadi with many straight arrows.

sa: तत्त्वतो वै समाचक्ष्व सर्वमध्वर्युसत्तम। यचात्र कारणं ब्रह्मन् कार्यस्यास्य विनिश्चये॥
en: O foremost of all Adhyaryus, tell me in full what was the reason for undertaking such a mission."

sa: निहतेषु तु योधेषु हते दुर्योधने तदा। पृथिव्यां पाण्डवेयस्य नि:सपत्ने कृते युधि॥ विद्रुते शिबिरे शून्ये प्राप्ते यशसि चोत्तमे। किं न तत् कारणं ब्रह्मन् येन कृष्णो गतः पुनः॥
en: When all the warriors were killed and Duryodhana was struck down, when for the battle the empire of Pandu's son became perfectly safe, when all the (Kuru) camp became empty, when the son of Pandu won great glory, what was the cause for which Krishna had once again to go (to Hastinapura)?

sa: भीष्म उवाच नित्योद्युक्तेन वै राज्ञा भवितव्यं युधिष्ठिर। प्रशस्यते न राजा हि नारीवोद्यमवर्जितः॥
en: 'The king, O Yudhishthira, should always address himself for action. That king does not deserve praise who, like a woman, is destitute of exertion.

sa: असमंजाः सरय्वां स पौराणां बालकान् नृप। न्यमज्जयदत: पित्रा निर्भर्त्य स विवासितः॥
en: Asamanjas, O king, used to drown the children of the citizens in the Sarayu. His father, therefore, remonstrated with and exiled him.

sa: लोकरञ्जनमेवात्र राज्ञां धर्मः सनातनः। सत्यस्य रक्षणं चैव व्यवहारस्य चार्जवम्॥
en: To make their subjects happy, to observe truth and to act sincerely are the eternal duties of kings.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं शतेनाजी विव्याध भरतर्षभ। भीमसेनं च सप्तत्या सहदेवं च पञ्चभिः॥
en: He struck Yudhishthira, O best of Bharata's race, with a hundred arrows and Bhimasena with seventy and Sahadeva with seven.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा सम्मुखे द्वीपी आत्मनः सदृशं पशुम्। अविरुद्धस्ततस्तस्य क्षणेन समपद्यत॥
en: Meanwhile, seeing before him an animal of his own species, the leopard, forthwith renounced all feelings of enmity towards it.

sa: एते चैवापरे चैव दोषाः प्रादुर्भवन्त्युत। नृपतौ मार्दवोपेत हर्षुले च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: If the king is mild and disposed to cut jokes. O Yudhishthira, these and many other evils originate from it.

sa: संजय उवाच शल्यस्तु कर्णार्जुनयोर्विमर्दे बलानि दृष्ट्वा मृदितानि बाणैः। ययौ हते चाथिरथौ पदानुगे रथेन संछिन्नपरिच्छदेन॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing the soldiers assailed with shafts in the encounter between Karna and Arjuna, Shalya, worked up with anger, pursued on that car shorn of its equipment's.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। उपारमत् ततः पार्थः कनीयानभ्यभाषत॥
en: Having said so, King Yudhishthira just stopped. His younger brother Arjuna then addressed him as follows.

sa: जनक उवाच आगमे यदि वापाये ज्ञातीनां द्रविणस्य च। नरेण प्रतिपत्तव्यं कल्याणं कथमिच्छता॥
en: Janaka said How should a man seeking his own wellbeing act upon occasions of the accession and the destruction of both kinsmen and wealth?-

sa: संतानमावयोस्तात वृद्धयोर्हतराज्ययोः। कथमन्धद्वयस्यास्य यष्टिरेका न वर्जिता॥
en: Why did you not leave even one crutch for this blind couple?

sa: सर्वो विमृशते जन्तुः कृच्छुस्थो धर्मदर्शनम्। पदस्थः पिहितं द्वारं परलोकस्य पश्यति॥
en: In difficulty, every one forgets considerations of virtue. They then see the portals of the other world as being closed.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अहो बत महद् दुःखं यदहं पाण्डवान् रणे। क्षेमिणश्चाव्ययांश्चैव त्वत्त: सूत शृणोमि वै॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Alas, O Suta, painful is the news that I hear from you viz., that the Pandavas are all safe and have suffered no loss in battle!

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज सहसा समुपाद्रवत्॥ पुत्रः पञ्चालराजस्य जिघांसुः कुञ्जरान् ययौ।
en: Beholding this, O king, Dhrishtadyumna, the son of the Panchala king proceeded towards those elephants to kill them.

sa: भीमसेनो रणे शल्यं शल्यभूतं पराक्रमे। एकेन विद्ध्वा बाणेन पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: Then Bhimasena in that battle, having cut Shalya who had become irresistible with one arrow, next struck him with seven.

sa: उपप्लव्यं गता सा तु श्रुत्वा सुमहदप्रियम्। तदा विनाशं सर्वेषां पुत्राणां व्यथिताभवत्॥
en: She had been living at Upaplavya. Having heard that heart-rending news about the destruction of all her sons, she became exceedingly moved.

sa: परिवार्य रथैः शल्यं पीडयामासुराहवे। तमेकं बहुभिर्दृष्ट्वा पीड्यमानं महारथैः॥ साधुवादो महाञ्जज्ञे सिद्धाश्चासन् प्रहर्षिताः। आश्चर्यमित्यभाषन्त मुनयश्चापि सङ्गताः॥
en: Beholding the helpless Shalya thus assailed by those great car-warriors loud sounds of applause were hcard and the Siddhas became filled with delight. The ascetics, assembled together, declared it wonderful.

sa: तदनीकं तदा पार्थो व्यधमद् बहुभिः शरैः॥ पातयित्वा हयान् सर्वास्त्रिगर्तानां रथान् ययौ।
en: Indeed, Partha, with many arrows, destroyed that (cavalry). Having. killed all the horses, he then proceeded against the cars of the Trigartas.

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन तीक्ष्णेन च परंतपः। दुर्विमोचनमाहत्य प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then that scorcher of foes, with another broad-headed and keen arrow, struck Durvimochana and killed him.

sa: न हि प्रमादात् परमस्ति कश्चिद् वधो नराणामिह जीवलोके। ते प्रमत्तमर्था हि नरं समन्तात् त्यजन्त्यनाश्च समाविशन्ति॥
en: There is, in this world, no greater cause of death, for men, than carelessness. Prosperity leaves off a careless men from every side, and every king of misery befalls him.

sa: पाण्डवानां वधे रात्रौ बुद्धिस्तेन प्रदर्शिता॥ एतच्छुत्वा तु वचनं गान्धार्या सहितोऽब्रवीत्। धृतराष्ट्रो महाबाहुः केशवं केशिसूदनम्॥ शीघ्रं गच्छ महाबाहो पाण्डवान् परिपालय।
en: It seems that he had formed a plan for destroying the Pandavas during the night.'.-Hearing these words, both Gandhari and Dhritarashtra said Keshava, the destroyer of Keshin, these words— 'Go quickly, O mighty-armed one, and protect the Pandavas.

sa: सा कृपा सा च ते प्रीतिः क्क सा राजन् सुमानिता। कथं विनिहतः पार्थैः संयुगेष्वपराजितः॥
en: Where now, O king, is that pity of yours, that love and that respectfulness? Invincible you were in battle, how, alas, have you been killed by the Parthas?

sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषामश्वत्थामा महाबलः। भित्वा पाञ्चालराजस्य तदनीकं दुरुत्सहम्॥ कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च प्रययौ यत्र सौबलः। रथानीकं परित्यज्य शूराः सुदृढधन्विनः॥
en: Hearing these words, the powerful Ashvatthaman, cutting through that irresistible force of the Panchala king, went with Kripa and Kritavarman, where Subala's son was. Infect leaving the car-force, those heroes, those firm bowmen, went to find out Duryodhana.

sa: दुर्योधने हते शल्ये विदुतेषु कृपादिषु॥ ह्रदं द्वैपायनं नाम विवेश भृशदुःखितः।
en: After Shalya's fall and the fight of Kripa and the others, Duryodhana, in great sorrow had entered the Dvaipayana lake.

sa: द्रौपदी च परिविष्टा सभामध्ये रजस्वला॥ द्यूते न वञ्चितो राजा यत् त्वया सौबलेन च।
en: Remember the ill-treatment of Draupadi, while in her season, in the midst of the assembly! Remember how yourself and Subala's son deprived the king at dice.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। उपारमत् ततः पार्थः कनीयानभ्यभाषत॥
en: Having said so, King Yudhishthira just stopped. His younger brother Arjuna then addressed him as follows.

sa: नापयाति भयात् कृष्णं संग्रामाद् यदि चेन्मम॥ निहतं विद्धि वार्ष्णेय धार्तराष्ट्रं सुबालिशम्।
en: take the foolish of Dhritarashtra as dead, O Vrishni hero, if, O Krishna, he does not today fly away from the battle,

sa: ननु रामोऽब्रवीद् राजंस्त्वां सदा यदुनन्दनः। दुर्योधनसमो नास्ति गदया इति वीर्यवान्॥
en: The valiant Rama of Yadu's family, O king, always used to see that there is 11O one equal to Duryodhana.

sa: तत् सैन्यं भरतश्रेष्ठ वध्यमानं किरीटिना। सम्प्रदुद्राव संग्रामात् तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: That army, O chief of the Bharatas' thus struck by Kiritin, fled away before the very eyes of your son.

sa: अद्य ता अपि रोत्स्यन्ति सर्वा नागपुरे स्त्रियः॥ श्रुत्वा पतींश्च पुत्रांश्च पाण्डवैर्निहतान् युधि।
en: Hearing of the destruction of their husbands and sons at the hands of the Pandavas in battle, all the ladies of Hastinapur will cry.

sa: निकृत्या वै दुराचारो यानि रत्नानि सौबलः॥ सभायामहरद् द्यूते पुनस्तान्याहराम्यहम्।
en: I shall regain all those valuable properties which Subala's wicked son won from us at the gambling match.

sa: त्वद्य समरं कृष्ण न हास्यन्ति मदोत्कटाः॥ तान् वै सर्वान् हनिष्यामि यद्यपि स्युर्न मानुषाः।
en: Even if they be superhuman beings, O Krishna! I shall yet kill all those warriors today if only they do not fly away from the battlefield.

sa: असंशयं पुण्यशीलः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्। त्रिविष्टपे पुण्यतमं स्थानं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
en: Forsooth, a person of righteous deeds acquires a high end. By such deeds men earn highly happy regions in heaven.

sa: प्रापतत् तच्च सहसा पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्। दधारैको रणे शल्यो वेलोवृत्तमिवार्णवम्॥
en: Shalya suddenly attacked the mighty army of the Pandavas. Alone he withstood it like the continent withstanding the surging deep.

sa: एवमस्त्विति स प्राह प्रह्लादो विस्मितस्तदा। उपाकृत्य तु विप्राय वरं दुःखान्वितोऽभवत्॥
en: Wondering much, Prahlada at last said,-Let it be so!-Having, however, granted the boon, the Asura king became filled with grief.

sa: एतच्छुत्वा महाराज वचनं मम साम्प्रतम्॥ प्रत्युद्याहि रणे पार्थ मद्रराजं महारथम्।
en: Hearing, O king, these words of mind now, proceed, O Partha, against that great carwarrior, the king of the Madras.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तत: साध्वी देहं त्यक्त्वा दिवं गता। ऋषिरप्यभवद् दीनस्तस्या रूपं विचिन्तयन्॥
en: Having said these words, that chaste lady left for heaven. Her husband the Rishi, became very disspiiited by thinking of her beauty.

sa: ताभ्यां सर्वे हि कार्यार्था मनुष्याणां नरर्षभ। विचेष्टन्तः स्म दृश्यन्ते निवृत्तास्तु तथैव च।॥
en: All human acts, O foremost of men, are accomplished by the aid of these two together. Influenced by these two, men either actor abstain.

sa: वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि जगुश्चाप्सरसां गणाः। न चाहितमनिष्टं च किञ्चित्तत्र प्रदृश्यते॥
en: All kinds of celestial instruments played in the sky and the Apsaras began to sing. No evil portent appeared there.

sa: रक्षया स हि तेषां वै महत् सुखमवाप्नुयात्। प्रजापतिर्हि वैश्याय सृष्ट्वा परिददौ पशून्॥
en: By looking after the (domestic) animals he would secure great happiness. Having created the (domestic) animals, the Creator, assigned their care to the Vaishyas.

sa: दत्ते वरे गते विप्रे चिन्ताऽऽसीन्महती तदा। प्रह्लादस्य महाराज निश्चयं न च जग्मिवान्॥
en: Having received the boon, the Brahmana went away, but Prahlada, O king, was stricken with a deep anxiety and knew not what to do.

sa: यदि कौतूहलं तेऽस्ति व्रज माधव मा चिरम्। पश्य युद्धं महाघोरं शिष्ययोर्यदि मन्यसे॥
en: If you feel any curiosity, then hasten O Madhava, without delay! Go, if you like and witness that terrible battle between your two disciples!'

sa: ततस्ते धर्मनिरताः सम्यक् तैरभिपूजिताः। श्वः समेष्याम इत्युक्त्वा यथेष्टं त्वरिता ययुः॥
en: Always righteous those sages, thus adored by Keshava and others, quickly went to their respective habitations saying-We will return tomorrow.'

sa: तथा प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे घोररूपे भयानके॥ तावकानां परेषां च नासीत् कश्चित् पराङ्मुखः।
en: Indeed, during that terrible and awful battle, no one, among either your warriors or those of the foc, took to his heels.

sa: संशयो मे महानेष समुत्पन्नः पितामह। छेत्ता च तस्य नान्योऽस्ति त्वत्तः परपुरजय॥
en: This great doubt has occupied my mind. There is no other person than you, Osubjugator of hostile towns, who can remove it!

sa: कृतवर्मणा नृशंसेन गौतमेन कृपेण च। अश्वत्थाम्ना च पापे हतं वः शिविरं निशि॥
en: During the night, O king, your camp has been exterminated by the cruel Kritavarman, and Kripa the son of Gotama, and the sinful Ashvatthaman.

sa: तव पुत्रे गते स्वर्गं शोकार्तस्य ममानघ। ऋषिदत्तं प्रणष्टं तद् दिव्यदर्शित्वमद्य वै॥
en: After your son's death, I was stricken with grief and the spiritual insight which the Rishi gave, has been lost by me.”

sa: परिश्रान्तश्च नकुलः सहदेवश्च भारत। योधयित्वा रणे पापान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् सहानुगान्॥
en: Both Nakula and Sahadeva, O Bharata, are worn out having fought with the wretched। Dhartarashtras and their followers.

sa: भीष्म उवाच विदिताः सर्व एवेह धर्मास्तव युधिष्ठिर। यथा मम महाबाहो विदिताः साधुसम्मताः॥
en: Bhishma said 'O Yudhishthira of mighty-arms, all th duties which are practised in this world by the righteous are known to you and me.

sa: एवं ते समयं कृत्वा सर्वे तत्र महारथाः॥ मद्रराजं पुरस्कृत्य तूर्णमभ्यद्रवन् परान्।
en: Having made this contact those great carworriers placed the king of the Madras at their head and speedily ran against their foes.

sa: मन्यमानः प्रभावं च कृष्णस्यामिततेजसः। तेन न च्यावितश्चाहं क्षत्रधर्मात् स्वनुष्ठितात्॥
en: I am not ignorant of the glory of Krishna. He had not made me disregard the Kshatriya duties!

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा यमौ भीमार्जुनावपि॥ भूतानीव समस्तानि ययुः कृष्णनिवेशनम्।
en: King Yudhishthira, the twins Bhima and Arjuna, the five resembling the five elements, then proceeded towards Krishna's mansion.
